title: 第十三章   红莲剑诀
content_zh:
黑袍人口中念念有词，地下无数的小水珠冒出，然后飞快地朝他身上飞去，在他身上不停地集结，一只人形的水团将他包裹住，随着小水珠的加入急速的变大，眨眼之间，一个三人高的水巨人出现了。

    水巨人高高跃起，朝魂八子袭击去。

    厌火虚影一闪，双刀上冒出熊熊烈火，用不可思议的速度冲到魂八子面前。

    面对来势汹汹，想要一击必杀的三人，魂八子停下了脚步，表现得从容不迫。身后四道流光闪动，分别对上射来羽人的羽箭。

    然后不慌不忙，用剑法中最平凡，最朴实的一招，直刺，迎上了厌火。本来厌火的脑海中，已经推演出了几十种的刀法，但是在这朴实无华的一剑面前，除了退，别无选择。

    已经高高跃起的水巨人，在水珠的不断加持下，身体还在不断地变大。半空中的水巨人，对着魂八子一拳击出，水巨人的胳膊变成一股水流，狂暴地冲向魂八子。

    魂八子剑袋中的最后一把剑，直接对上了水流，逆着水流方向，直接冲进水巨人身体里，插在被黑袍人胸口。

    原本已经退开的厌火，突然感觉到他的意识在飞快地剥离他的身体，喉咙一凉。

    他到死都没明白，一个御剑术的剑士，为什么有这么快的剑。

    羽人刚展开双翼，就看到两名同伴已经被杀，连忙放弃了继续攻击的念头，一心准备逃跑。抬头准备加速飞行，就看到四把长剑悬在上方，从上而下化为四道白影。紧接着四股巨大的力量将他的四肢拉扯住，狠狠地朝地面摔去。

    等他反应过来时候，自己被四把长剑穿过四肢钉在了地下。

    剧烈的疼痛从四肢发出，让他清醒过来，魂八子并未马上出现，他隐隐约约地听到，魂八子自言自语地说些什么。

    魂八子自言自语的语音刚楼下，魂八子就站在他的旁边，他刚才已经猜想到了魂八子留下他活口的原因，现在就等魂八子来问。

    可魂八子并没有问他，而是弯下了腰，拔出了他左腿的剑，很恭敬地说道：“3哥辛苦了。”用布很仔细地擦拭干净后，恭恭敬敬地放入剑袋内。

    拔出左臂上的剑，恭敬地说：“四哥辛苦了。”

    “五哥辛苦了。”

    “六哥辛苦了。”

    一直到最后一把剑恭敬地放入剑袋，然后将剑袋背起后，眼光才落在羽人的身上。

    “说说吧。”魂八子是用的夏人语言问道。

    在漫长的历史中，羽人和夏人曾经有一段很美好的蜜月期，在那段时间，大家不分彼此，所有羽人语言和夏人语言，除了一些词语，几乎都可以通用。

    可惜的是后来由于某种原因，让两族彻底翻脸，最后变成了宿敌。

    “卑鄙的夏人。”失去行动能力的羽人，把头一偏，以示抵抗。

    “你最好乖乖地回答，我就放过你，要不然我就扒光你的毛。”魂八子望着羽人，认真地说道。
content_en:
The man in black robe muttered something, and countless small water droplets emerged from the ground, then flew towards him quickly, and kept gathering on him. A human-shaped water ball enveloped him, and as the small water droplets joined, it rapidly grew in size. In the blink of an eye, a water giant three people tall appeared.

    The water giant jumped up high and attacked Hun Bazi.

    The shadow of Yan Huo flashed, blazing fire burst out from his two swords, and he rushed in front of Hun Bazi at an incredible speed.

    Facing the menacing three men who wanted to kill them with one strike, Hun Bazi stopped and acted calmly. Four streams of light flashed behind him, and they were shot at the Yuren's feather arrows.

    Then he calmly used the most ordinary and simple move in swordsmanship, a straight thrust, to meet Yan Huo. Yan Huo had already deduced dozens of sword techniques in his mind, but in front of this simple sword, he had no choice but to retreat.

    The water giant, which is already leaping high, is still growing bigger with the continuous blessing of water drops. The water giant in mid-air punched Hun Bazi. The water giant's arm turned into a stream of water and rushed towards Hun Bazi violently.

    The last sword in Hunbazi's sword bag was directly facing the water flow. Against the direction of the water flow, it rushed directly into the body of the water giant and was inserted into the chest of the man in black robe.

    Yanhuo, who had already retreated, suddenly felt his consciousness peeling away from his body quickly, and his throat felt cold.

    Until his death, he never understood why a swordsman with swordsmanship had such a fast sword.

    As soon as Yu Ren spread his wings, he saw that his two companions had been killed. He quickly gave up the idea of ​​continuing to attack and prepared to escape. When he raised his head and prepared to speed up his flight, he saw four long swords hanging above, turning into four white shadows from top to bottom. Then four huge forces pulled his limbs and threw him violently towards the ground.

    When he reacted, four long swords penetrated his limbs and were pinned to the ground.

    Severe pain emanated from his limbs, causing him to wake up. Hun Bazi did not appear immediately. He vaguely heard Hun Bazi saying something to himself.

    Just as Hun Bazi was talking to himself downstairs, Hun Bazi was standing next to him. He had just guessed the reason why Hun Bazi kept him alive, and now he was waiting for Hun Bazi to ask.

    But Hun Bazi didn't ask him, but bent down, pulled out the sword from his left leg, and said respectfully: "Thank you for your hard work, Brother 3." After wiping it clean with a cloth, he respectfully put it into the sword bag.

    He pulled out the sword on his left arm and said respectfully: "Thank you for your hard work, fourth brother."

    "Thank you for your hard work, Fifth Brother."

    "Thank you for your hard work, Sixth Brother."

    It wasn't until the last sword was respectfully put into the sword bag and the sword bag was put on his back that his eyes fell on Yu Ren.

    "Tell me about it." Hun Bazi asked in Xia language.

    In the long history, the Yu people and the Xia people had a wonderful honeymoon period. During that time, no one could distinguish between each other, and almost all Yu people and Xia people could use the same language, except for some words.

    It's a pity that due to some reasons, the two races completely fell out and eventually became old enemies.

    "Despicable Xia Ren." Yu Ren, who was unable to move, tilted his head to show resistance.

    "You'd better answer obediently, and I'll let you go, or I'll strip you naked." Hun Bazi looked at Yuren and said seriously.
